title: The hardware store's new sign
logline: Wagner's building on main street, empty three years after the corner, and this summer a new sign going up on it — skateboards — a young man on a ladder with a drill, from behind. The building the strip drew closing, opening. The page counts the years on its fingers and doesn't letter them.

panels.composition: A main-street building's front with a young man on a ladder from behind drilling a new sign with a skateboard shape onto the fascia above an old hardware store's painted-over lettering.
